overview_description.description: Jitsu is an open-source data integration and event collection platform for modern data teams. The platform will automatically resolve user geo-location based on IP address and parse user agents to filter out bots and understand device type. Jitsu can also pull data from 140+ external services to create a completely accurate profile of the users. It aims to ensure that all your business data is consolidated in a single database and ready for analytics.

product.name: Jitsu Event Data Collection Platform
product.description: An open-source platform that collects event data from various sources and streams it in real-time to data warehouses for analysis.

product.name: Jitsu Functions
product.description: A developer tool that allows modification, filtering, or augmentation of event data before storage using JavaScript.

product.name: Jitsu Private Cloud
product.description: A dedicated single-tenant deployment of Jitsu hosted on a customer or Jitsu-managed cloud account.

product.name: Jitsu On Premises Deployment
product.description: A deployment option allowing Jitsu to be installed and run on a customer's own infrastructure or cloud environment.

product.name: Jitsu Cloud
product.description: A cloud-hosted version of the Jitsu platform providing event data collection and streaming services without self-hosting.
